evidence.title: ADDA: a Modular Framework for Representing, Simulating and Assimilating Dynamics with End-to-end Differentiability

summary: ADDA (Adaptive Dynamics Differentiable Architecture) provides a unified platform that can represent, simulate, and assimilate complex dynamical processes while maintaining full gradient flow for optimization. The framework aims to accelerate research in physics‑informed machine learning and control by enabling seamless integration of simulation and data‑driven inference.
title: Researchers introduce ADDA, a modular, end-to-end differentiable framework for simulating and assimilating dynamic systems
